title: Avalon: Legacy Edition announcement
body:
Almost 30 years ago, we sat behind a screen together as brothers, making games. Now, decades later, Bowie and I have joined forces once again. And it feels just as amazing as it did back then! 🚀

We are currently working hard on Avalon: Legacy Edition, and we are already making great progress. It’s incredible to see the game come to life step by step. We are absolutely thrilled with how it’s turning out, especially since we’ve managed to capture that old, familiar feeling from the past so well.

For those wondering what exactly we are building: Avalon is a pure, nostalgic tribute to the DOS RPGs of 1998, but carefully polished for modern systems. We are bringing back the days when games didn’t hold your hand with hours of tutorials or overly complex skill trees. The concept is simple: boot it up, grab your gear, and immediately set out on an adventure. Just like the classics from the ’90s.

In a tight 10 to 15-hour adventure, you step into the shoes of Mace on the mysterious planet of Avalon. The game revolves entirely around exploration, charming 2D combat, and solving quests. It’s made specifically for players who miss the feeling of discovering an unknown world and figuring things out for themselves.

It is incredibly special to share that old creative spark with Bowie again after all these years. We’ll be sharing more visuals of the world we’re building very soon.

Who else finds themselves longing for the pure, pick-up-and-play charm of ’90s RPGs? 🕹️✨
